questions.prompt: What must you do before opening a computer?
choices: Unplug it, drain the remaining power and wear a grounded wrist strap
questions.explanation: Remove mains power, drain standby power and ground yourself.

questions.prompt: Which memory loses its contents when the power is off?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile; the others are storage.

questions.prompt: A PC shows the IP address 169.254.8.20. What is the problem?
questions.explanation: 169.254.x.x is an APIPA address, used when DHCP fails.

questions.prompt: Which is the third wire in T568B?
questions.explanation: White-orange, orange, white-green, blue, white-blue, green, white-brown, brown.

questions.prompt: Which repair should you try before Reset this PC?
questions.explanation: Use the least destructive repairs first.

questions.prompt: Printed pages smudge when touched. Which part is faulty?
questions.explanation: The fuser melts toner onto the paper.

questions.prompt: A PSU tester shows +12 V at 12.9 V. Is it acceptable?
choices: No, it is above the 12.60 V maximum

questions.prompt: Which should you NOT do to an SSD?
questions.explanation: Defragmenting adds wear without benefit; Windows uses TRIM.

questions.prompt: Put the troubleshooting steps in order.
questions.explanation: Always end by verifying and documenting.

questions.prompt: Which does Windows 11 require? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: No optical drive is needed; it installs from USB.
